title: The Clock That Keeps Itself

mood.label: Under strain
mood.summary: A heavy Sunday centred on the Gulf — Houthi strikes on Riyadh airport, Iran talks stalled — plus twenty killed in Zaporizhzhia, 139 drowned off Djibouti, a hurricane and a big quake. Small bright notes: a nuclear clock, new parks, thriving tortoises.

lines: Sunday came in through the airport smoke,
The Hormuz talks have gone quiet,
Off Djibouti the boat went under,
Isaias took the Gulf Coast light,
Panama shook and a building fell —
the storm and the quake spared every life.
Somewhere a clock keeps its own time,
Tortoises counted by the hundred thousand,
three new parks in the Victoria green.
